Record Class MediaOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.client.media.MediaOptions
Record Components:
width - decoded video/image canvas width
height - decoded canvas height
fps - video sampling rate
audio - enable an audio stream when available
loop - restart after the presentation reaches its end
encodedByteLimit - maximum resource/URL bytes to spool; local files are streamed directly
public record MediaOptions(int width, int height, int fps, boolean audio, boolean loop, long encodedByteLimit) extends Record
Bounded decoding settings. These values describe the output, not a claim that every source has this resolution.

    • MediaOptions

      public MediaOptions(int width, int height, int fps, boolean audio, boolean loop, long encodedByteLimit)
      Rejects invalid settings before starting a worker or native process.
      Parameters:
      width - output width, 1–4096
      height - output height, 1–4096
      fps - output frames per second, 1–120
      audio - allow sound
      loop - repeat on end
      encodedByteLimit - positive encoded-source limit

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
